comment: Phase 1i.C synthetic Component-6 cases.  All content is synthetic per coordinator pin C2 — no real PII.  Cases are SHAPED like the user's manual-smoke failures (family_kids_missing, stock_followup_off_topic) but the literal text is invented.  Every case has expected_facts_to_surface (substring match against rendered_block) and a head_known_fail flag for HEAD baseline tracking.
